t: What is the difference between a pigment mix and a hue? (acrylic paints) - WetCanvas: Online Living for Artists
s: April 29, 2015 - If it doesn’t have “hue” after the name it means it’s either a pure pigment or it’s a specialty color that is made up of a combination of pigments but is not trying to imitate a pure pigment. ... Focus on the pigments as opposed to the color names because there are no standards for color names. For example, Hansa Yellow Medium by Golden Paints uses the same PY73 as Utrecht’s Azo Yellow Medium. If you don’t see the pigment on the tube or jar, buy something else.
